verification.title: Identity Verification
verification.header_subtitle: Verify your identity as a fencer to access all features
verification.desc_association_card: Take a photo of your fencing association registration card
verification.desc_mask_photo:
Take a photo with your fencing mask
and a paper showing your name and date
verification.desc_uniform_photo:
Take a photo in your fencing uniform
and a paper showing your name and date
verification.upload_placeholder: Click or drag an image here
verification.guide_association_card: Take a photo of your fencing association card. Make sure the name, registration number, and affiliation are visible.
verification.guide_mask_photo:
Take a photo with your fencing mask and a paper showing today's date and your name.
If your mask has your name, include it in the photo.
verification.guide_uniform_photo:
Take a photo in your fencing uniform with a paper showing today's date and your name.
If your uniform has your name, include it in the photo.
verification.axis_document_verified: Your submitted document or photo passed review. This is separate from linking your competition record.
verification.axis_document_review: Your submitted document or photo is being reviewed.
verification.axis_document_rejected: Your submitted document or photo was rejected.
verification.axis_document_none: You have not submitted a document or photo yet.
verification.axis_player_verified: Your competition record (player profile) is linked to this account.
verification.axis_player_review: An administrator is reviewing your record link request.
verification.axis_player_rejected: Your record link request was rejected.
verification.axis_player_none: No competition record (player profile) is linked to this account yet.
verification.axis_parent_verified: Your relationship to the player has been confirmed.
verification.axis_parent_review: Your request is under review. For the safety of minors, an administrator confirms it manually.
verification.axis_org_review: Your organization ownership request is under review.
verification.axis_org_rejected: Your organization ownership request was rejected.
verification.axis_org_none: No club or school is linked yet.
verification.next_document_review: Please wait for the result. We will email your account when review finishes.
verification.next_document_disabled: Photo verification is not available yet. You will be able to submit here once it is ready.
verification.next_document_submit: Choose a verification method below and submit a photo.
verification.next_document_player_only: Photo verification is available when your member type is Player.
verification.next_player_review: Once approved, your competition record is linked automatically. Nothing else is needed from you.
verification.next_player_claim: Search for your competition record by name below and request the link.
verification.next_player_change_type: Change your member type to Player or Coach to link a competition record.
verification.next_parent_review: Please wait for the administrator's confirmation. We will email your account.
verification.next_parent_claim: Search for your child by name below and request confirmation.
verification.next_parent_change_type: Change your member type to Parent to verify a parent-child relationship.
verification.next_org_review: Please wait for the administrator's confirmation. We will email your account.
verification.next_org_claim: Search for your club or school below and submit the business registration certificate.
verification.next_org_change_type: Change your member type to Director to verify organization ownership.
verification.player_claim_desc: Search competition records by your name and link one to this account. An administrator reviews every request before approval.
verification.msg_no_result: No results. Check the spelling of the name or the birth year.
verification.photo_disabled_body: Automatic photo review is not connected yet, so a submission would not be processed. Uploads are closed for now to avoid wasted submissions. Linking your competition record is enough to proceed with player verification.
verification.general_desc: Your member type is General. General members have no verification to apply for. Change your member type in your profile to one of the following and you can complete that verification here.
verification.type_player_desc: Link your own competition record (player profile) to this account.
verification.type_parent_desc: Confirm your relationship to a player to see their records.
verification.type_director_desc: Confirm club or school ownership with a business registration certificate.

profile.delete_lead: Deleting your account works as follows. Please read this before continuing.
profile.delete_fact_schedule_prefix: Your request is accepted immediately, and deletion of your member data is scheduled
profile.delete_fact_grace: During that period your account stays active and you can cancel the deletion from this page.
profile.delete_fact_purge: After the scheduled date, member data such as your name, email, phone number and login connections is destroyed.
profile.delete_fact_legal: Records we are legally required to retain are kept separately for the required period.
profile.delete_fact_records: Competition results come from public Korea Fencing Federation data, so they are not deleted — only the link to your account is removed.
profile.delete_legal_note: See Article 13 of the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy for details.
profile.delete_confirm_suffix: exactly as shown in the field below.
profile.delete_error: Could not process the deletion request. Please try again in a moment.
profile.deletion_scheduled_lead: Your deletion request was accepted. Your member data will be destroyed on the date below.
profile.deletion_cancel_note: You can cancel until the scheduled date. Cancelling keeps your account and settings unchanged.
profile.cancel_deletion_btn: Cancel deletion and keep my account
profile.cancel_error: Could not cancel the deletion. Please try again in a moment.
